headline: Port Samaná revitalizes the cruise tourism bet in the area
summary: Port Samaná is reviving its cruise tourism strategy in the Dominican Republic's northeast. More than 2,045 cruise passengers arrived at Arroyo Barril on the reported day.
why: Tourism is a major source of foreign-exchange earnings and employment for the Dominican Republic, and cruise arrivals are one channel for that revenue.
original_headline: Port Samaná revitaliza la apuesta del turismo de cruceros en la zona
